title: Jumping Squares backup file (v1)
description: Shape (structural) schema for a Jumping Squares Save/Load backup file. This describes the file FORMAT only. It cannot express game-rule (semantic) validity such as point conservation, the turn-gate, the winner rule, or the no-mid-cascade rule - those are checked separately by tools/validate-rules.js, which runs the board through the game engine's loadState. A file that passes THIS schema is well-formed; a file that also passes validate-rules.js is loadable by the app.

format.description: Fixed tag identifying the file as a Jumping Squares backup.

formatVersion.description: Backup wrapper format version this schema describes.

engineVersion.description: The game build (VERSION) that wrote the file. Informational.

savedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the file was written. Informational.

board.description: Optional game-board section (present when 'Game board' was selected on export).

format.description: Fixed tag identifying the board section's envelope.

state.description: The engine board state (an engine cloneState snapshot).

turnsTaken.description: Per-player turn counts; index 0 unused (so length is players+1).

cells.description: Flat row-major array of cells; length must equal rows*cols (a cross-field rule the validator checks beyond this schema).

prefs.description: Optional settings & scores section (present when 'Settings & scores' was selected on export). Adopted leniently by the app field-by-field, so only loosely constrained here; unknown fields are ignored on import.
